title: Jake Barber's orbs phasing into mountains over the range

tellings.quote: Didn't Jake Barber talk about some of the like light orbs or weird non really physically identifiable craft he'd see over the range would like almost phase into mountains

plain: Glowing orbs and strange craft that were hard to pin down as physical things would fly over a test range in California and seem to pass right into the mountains, according to a man named Jake Barber. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb brings this up second-hand, asking whether Barber hadn't described light orbs that would "almost phase into mountains". If true, the objects would be doing something no known aircraft can do.
